layout.ab: Ruling is visible. Pricking has been partly cut off.

handNote.seg: Clear, but not very accurate hand.
Titles, the names of Mary and Jesus, the names of the scribe and of the owner are rubricated.

item.desc: Some spaces left for rubricated titles have been left unfilled, especially from the 2nd to the 23rd Ṭǝqǝmt.

The names of the following persons (the scribe, the owner and members of his family) are mentioned in the supplications after the commemorations: Minās, Tawalda Madḫǝn, Fǝqra ʾIyasus, Kidāna Wald, Takla Hāymānot, Walda ʾEwosṭātewos, Walda ʾƎgziʾ, Walatta Śǝllāse, ʿĀmata Śǝllāse, Walatta Ṣǝyon, Mārtā, Walda Giyorgis, Kǝnfa Mikāʾel.
Ex libris of James Bruce glued on the inner front board, containing shelfmarks of the manuscript: 82. Aeth. Cat. 4. Bruce of Kinnaird Nº 9
A pagemark of blue textile was sewn to the headband. It has been torn off the headband and is now placed inside the manuscript.

item.q: በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ግጻዌ፡ ዘቅዱስ፡ አባ፡ መቃርስ፡ ዘደብረ፡ አስቄጥስ። ወከማሁ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ካዕበ፡ ውስተ፡ መጽሐፈ፡ ግጻዌ፡ ዘላዕላይ፡ ግብጽ፡
hoc die Romaei festum Stephani celebrant.

binding.decoNote: European binding, red leather with gilded borders. Printed on the spine: Synaxar. Cover of the inner board and first fly-leaf gilded and imprinted with geometrical pattern. The text block was trimmed and its edges gilded. The manuscript is very tightly bound. One paper fly leaf at the front and at the back, each containing a watermark. The three parchment guard leaves at the beginning are made of a different, probably European, parchment.
